title: idle-detection-trigger
intention: The cairn device detects system idleness — 3 hours without human activity — and starts a sleep-cycle token rotation. Collaborates with the system device for activity sensing.
why: Sleep cycles need a trigger, and the trigger is silence — 'it's not about a specific hour, it's about when other external things won't trouble it' (Akien, 2026-08-24). The screensaver analogy: fires on measured quiet, not on a clock.
traces_to: Telos aim 5 (self-improving) — sleep cycles are where learning consolidation happens, and idle detection is the trigger
Law 4 — the trigger is physics (a measured silence), not policy (a cron schedule)

proves_green.proof_gate: tester — the idle detection fires after the threshold and does not fire during activity, proved by teeth a hollow build could not pass

falsifier.proves_red: DONE when the cairn device starts a token rotation after the idle threshold is met, and does NOT start one while the system is active. WRONG INTENT if idle detection belongs somewhere other than the cairn device, or if the threshold model is wrong.
falsifier.horizon: first idle-triggered rotation is the first measurement

how: A timer or event-driven check on the cairn device that measures time since last human interaction, collaborating with the system device for activity sensing. When the threshold is crossed, it posts the sleep-cycle token on its announce feed. The '3 hours' is a tunable parameter, not a constant.

decisions.text: Reshaped by Akien's rulings, all later than this ticket's cast: (1) 2026-09-30 — it lives on the cairn device, which holds the system's only two clock uses, AWAY WINDOWS and SLEEP; the check runs when the ground loop's spawned pulse reaches the cairn device (entry `python3 -m cairn.devices.cairn pulse`), which decides for itself whether sleep is due, and mints the cycle through cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/token.py. No new system device (that answers open-91f17c211689's placement half). (2) 2026-09-29 (open-91f17c211689) — human activity is 'any time i interact with you, or any of our creations in cairn … you, the librarian, the web server, or the command line'; the check reads the latest of those four, each from a record its owner already writes, and a source it cannot read is named in the record, never treated as silence. (3) 2026-08-31 note — away windows: Akien declares 'away from x to y' (a `cairn away` verb on the cairn device, held in ~/.cairn/devices/cairn/0/away.json); inside a window sleep is due at once, without waiting for the threshold. (4) The 3h threshold is a declared config value on the cairn device whose provenance is Akien 2026-08-24 ('3 hours without a human'). The roster the cycle walks is devices whose shim answers `sleep` — 164da559823d's work, not this ticket's.
decisions.step: unlisted: rulings 2026-08-31, 09-29 and 09-30 place and shape the trigger

decisions.text: Corrects D1's last sentence: the sleep roster (rack devices whose device declares the `sleep` verb) is a808e21d646f's work, not 164da559823d's — measured 2026-09-30, 164da559823d does not carry it, and no sleeps_when_the_token_arrives.py exists, so the roster is empty until a device declares `sleep`. This ticket mints over whatever that roster returns; an empty roster closes at mint (sleep_cycle falsifier).
decisions.step: unlisted: correction to D1's roster pointer

decisions.text: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/sleep_cycle/idle.py latest_activity(since, roots, transcripts, pts) returns per source {at: iso|None, unread: reason|None}. cc = Claude Code's own transcripts at ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl (NOT under ~/.cairn/logs; only files modified after since are opened): a user entry counts when origin.kind=='human', or when it has no origin, entrypoint=='cli', and is neither a tool_result nor isMeta (typed slash commands carry no origin, measured 2026-10-17); peer, task-notification and sdk-cli entries never count. command_line = newest atime over /dev/pts/<digits>. web_server = newest UTC stamp in file names <yyyymmdd.hhmmss.us>.WebServerDevice.serve.json under log_path('web_server',0,roots); librarian = the same for .LibrarianDevice.chat.json under log_path('librarian',0,roots). A missing folder or any read error is recorded unread with its exception text, never as silence. No import from cc, librarian or web_server code (RULE 1).

CairnDevice.declared_verbs adds 'away' -> _handle_away: act set|show|clear over those helpers; a bad act or a bad window answers {accepted: False, reason}.

decisions.text: cairn/devices/cairn/__main__.py parses one subcommand 'pulse' and calls idle.pulse(), prints DUE/not due with the why, names each unread source on stderr, exits 0. idle.pulse(roots, now, threshold_s, transcripts, pts, ask): since = later of pulse.json's carried last_activity and now-threshold; last_activity = later of what was seen and the carried one, else now-threshold. decide(): an open cycle -> not due; anchor = the away window's start when inside it, else last_activity; a cycle opened at or after the anchor -> not due (one sleep per quiet spell); inside the window -> due; any unread source -> not due; quiet >= threshold -> due. When due, ask() (default reach('cairn').request(sender='cairn', to='cairn', verb='sleep-cycle', body={act: mint})) and record the minted cycle_id. pulse.json = token.cycle_dir(roots)/pulse.json, one record {at, due, why, threshold_s, last_activity, sources, minted}, atomically replaced.

World: temp roots, temp transcripts, temp pts with os.utime, an injected asker writing a closed cycle via token._write. Subjects imported at call time.

decisions.text: Transcript entry shape (measured 2026-10-17): one JSON object per line; type=='user' for a turn; timestamp is ISO-8601 UTC with a trailing Z (e.g. '2026-10-17T21:00:12.345Z', parsed by datetime.fromisoformat after Z->+00:00); origin is an optional dict whose kind is 'human'|'peer'|'task-notification'; entrypoint is 'cli'|'sdk-cli'; isMeta optional bool; message.content is a string or a list of blocks, a block {type:'tool_result'} marking a tool result. A line that is not JSON is skipped. Any exception from a reader (missing folder raises FileNotFoundError on purpose) is caught per source and recorded unread='<ExceptionType>: <message>'.
decisions.by: cc (builder), CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12 "approved thru PROVED, fastest route"

decisions.text: away.json shape: {start, end, why, set_at}, all times ISO-8601 UTC strings via datetime.isoformat() (start/end accepted as any fromisoformat string, Z allowed, normalised to UTC); set_at = now. Atomic write = write away.json.tmp then os.replace. read_away returns None when the file is missing (no window); show answers {away: <window>|None}; clear unlinks with missing_ok and answers {cleared: <the old window>|None}; set answers {away: <window>}.

decisions.text: _handle_away(self, envelope) is a new method on CairnDevice in cairn/devices/cairn/device.py, registered in declared_verbs as 'away' beside 'sleep-token' and 'sleep-cycle'; it reads body=envelope['body'] and dispatches body['act']: 'set' -> idle.set_away(body['start'], body['end'], body.get('why') or '', roots=self._roots); 'show' -> idle.read_away(self._roots); 'clear' -> idle.clear_away(self._roots); anything else -> {accepted: False, reason}.

decisions.text: Exact signatures and shapes. decide(sources: dict, last_activity: datetime, *, now: datetime, threshold_s: float, away: dict|None, cycle: dict|None) -> (due: bool, why: str); pure, reads no module state. pulse(*, roots=None, now=None, threshold_s=IDLE_THRESHOLD_S, transcripts=None, pts=None, ask=None) -> record. ask() is called with no arguments and returns the sleep-cycle verb's BODY; the default is _ask_mint(): reach('cairn').request(sender='cairn', to='cairn', verb='sleep-cycle', why=..., body={'act': 'mint'})['body'], and that body is {'cycle': {cycle_id, roster, position, visited, opened_at, closed_at, closed_by}} (plus 'logs' when the cycle closed at mint) — so minted = answer['cycle']['cycle_id'], or the whole answer when it carries no cycle. pulse.json record, exactly: {at: ISO str, due: bool, why: str, threshold_s: number, last_activity: ONE ISO str (the single latest activity across all sources, not a dict), sources: {cc|command_line|web_server|librarian: {at: ISO str|None, unread: str|None}} (a dict of all four, not a list), minted: cycle_id str|None}.
